rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a blastocyst with favorable ICM and TE consistent with 3AA and appropriately notes limits of single-image assessment; minor speculative comments about collapse/granularity and limited direct mention of zona thinning prevent a perfect score.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male factor, endometrium, first-cycle status, smoking, and untested embryo status into prognosis and transfer planning.
The reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with the implantation estimate clearly tied to embryo quality, age-related aneuploidy risk, smoking, and endometrial factors.

Recommendations are well aligned with standard IVF practice: single embryo transfer for a good-quality Day 5 blastocyst, avoidance of unproven add-ons, attention to luteal support, and appropriate optional framing of PGT-A.
Provides clear, practical next steps for the current transfer and contingency planning for failure, including smoking cessation, SET, review of embryology data, and when to consider further testing.
